title: Where can you find dependable partners for large-scale training data? [P]
summary: The project is growing, and we are trying partners capable of delivering big datasets on a steady basis, potentially millions of samples, backed by strong quality checks. I have looked into the major annotation providers, but their websites make it difficult to separate the ones
reason: Reddit post asking for recommendations on data-annotation partners; it announces no model, research artifact, business event, policy action, or open-source tool, so no active rule covers it.
